messages:
omar: Morning — ACME just told us they replayed an hourly export to catch missed rows. Our ledger shows overlapping claims and a handful of negative deltas. Can we triage?

katie: Can you drop a sample of their payloads? My initial thought: idempotency key mismatch (they changed event ids on retry).

acme-ing-engineer: sending sample now. we retried with new uuids; original events had x-partner-replay header missing. sample: ```json
{"customer_id":"C-900","usage_units":300,"ts":"2026-04-02T02:00:00Z","event_id":"evt-9999"}
```

claire: From reconciliation: same entitlement fingerprint but different event_id -> our dedupe by event_id can't catch it. 7 accounts with small negative nets so far.

sam: Support already flagged one paying customer who saw a credit blip. We need a short public note + ETA for correction.

omar: Proposal: (A) billing ops manual fix for affected accounts, (B) short-term ingest rule: require X-Partner-Replay or X-Replay-Id header for any bulk replays; otherwise reject with 422, (C) partner runbook update and partner-side test harness. Thoughts? @billing-ops-bot open-exception.

billing-ops-bot: Created EX-2026-487: "ACME replay overlap - ledger drift" assigned to @claire SLA 48h.

claire: I'll take EX-2026-487. Need CSV of original_event_id vs replay_event_id to map. Will run a dry reconcile and post diffs before applying credits/debits.

katie: I'll add the ingest guard and a short-term alert rule: replay_headers_missing > 0 triggers pager to #partnerships-alerts (severity low). Patch ETA: 2 hours.

sam: Drafted customer-facing note: apology, visible billing portal effect, remediation steps, ETA for crediting. Posting to #support-drafts in 15m.

omar: Also let's add a post-incident item: add a nightly partner-replay-audit that checks partner replay_id continuity and flags gaps. Add to the Partner Integration Spec requiring header and sample curl.

claire: Dry-run shows 7 accounts, total over-credit ~4,200 units. I'll attach SQL and reversal audit ids to EX-2026-487 and proceed once katie's guard is live.

katie: Guard merged to canary. Will roll to prod after 1h smoke. Added docs PR to Partner Integration Spec with example: `curl -H "X-Partner-Replay: 20260402-01"`.

omar: Thanks. Follow-up: schedule a 30m sync with ACME PM tomorrow to agree on replay SLA and automated test vectors. Closing loop for now. :thumbsup:
